command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
import pandas as pd

t = pq.read_table("/app/merged_users.parquet")
print("schema:", t.schema)
df = t.to_pandas()
print(df.to_string())
assert df["user_id"].dtype.kind == "i", df.dtypes
assert list(df["user_id"]) == [101, 102, 103, 104]
assert len(df) == df["user_id"].nunique()
import re
assert all(re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", d) for d in df["created_date"])

r = json.load(open("/app/conflicts.json"))
assert r["total_conflicts"] == len(r["conflicts"]) == 3
for c in r["conflicts"]:
    assert c["selected"] == c["values"]["source_a"], c
print("readback OK; conflicts:", r["total_conflicts"])

# consistency: merged values equal selected/first available priority value
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    for f in ["name", "email", "created_date", "status"]:
        if pd.notna(row[f]):
            assert isinstance(row[f], str), (f, type(row[f]))
print("value types OK")
EOF
